0071DF80 enumerates regular units and ConstructionSite separately. 00718CC0 resolves Construction ability at +17C+10 (index4 proven by 0086A710), obtains target type with 007D4DD0, increments foundation count +C; completed count is +8. 007194B0 compares minimum requirements only with +8. Completed buildings, not foundations, satisfy acquisition requirements.
00719280 chooses adjacentReq if own territory list from 0071F070 is empty. A landless player can acquire their first territory using a completed city center without a fortress.

00723BA0 builds territory neighbor pairs from horizontally/vertically consecutive grid cells only, not diagonal cells. 007217E0 requires neighbor owner to equal the same player; alliance is insufficient.
0071A340 checks current owner using undisputedReq; 0071E520 skips new acquisition while undisputed. Removing a fortress or losing adjacent land therefore does not revoke an existing city-based claim.

007196E0/0071A340 set state+60=2 on an existing owner failing undisputedReq while retaining owner+54. The reconstruction currently frees a territory after city-center destruction and has no full original disputed-ownership state.

0071B310 sums completed building counts across players plus construction counts belonging to the placing player, then compares maximumReq. The Fortress placement check now follows this distinction; existing city-center foundation exclusion remains a stricter adapter.

Previously exported 0071DDB0 directly transfers a territory and eligible owner objects, without calling adjacency/nonAdjacent acquisition gates. Current queue refund, crew and atomic-swap policies remain declared adapters.

DbUnitDefs.h says attackBonus per occupied SLOT, healPoints per second. Fortress has10slots, .03 attackBonus, heal2/4/6/8/10/12/14 at source epochs1/4/6/8/10/12/14. Eligibility is inherited Garrisonable.garrisonTypes, not inferred from a unit name.

007E63B0 returns1 for UnitTypeAttr Leaders (008574E0; mask D0125C initialized from literal C47CE4 by 00856320), otherwise the DWORD at UnitType+A0. 0053A0F0 registers name/offset pairs: C14970 points to literal popCount at C149DC, C14974 receives its property offset. 0053A8D0 reads this offset at 0053ACDC and writes the inherited value into UnitType+A0 at0053ACFE. Thus the ordinary slot cost is the original popCount. Registration and instructions independently checked against raw PE bytes.
Native BuildingCombat attack column in dbcombat.csv permits land, buildings and surface ships, excludes air/submarines. Full native RPS coefficient application remains outside this change.
